topology: Conformal blockMesh + nested box castellation with transition cells: reconstruction of reported resolution criteria, NOT identical topology to the paper's nonconformal cubic mesh.
assumptions: Unpublished zone bounds and exact spacings: nested boxes are ASSUMPTIONS, not fitted to approximately 400k cells.
Section orientation assigned y=24.4m, z=36.6m, centred at hub; symmetry follows figure despite contradictory no-slip prose.
CrankNicolson blend 0.9 and corrected nonorthogonal operators are explicit reconstruction choices; published PBiCG uses compatible DILU.

Inflow intensity 0.005 and mixing length 0.07D inherited; article epsilon conditions unspecified. Published nu=1.46e-5 m2/s and rho=1.23 kg/m3 retained; density is reference metadata, not a multiplier in the incompressible ALM force path.
Single-Re OSU pressure-drag S809 polar retained; not article multi-Re interpolation. liftReCorrExp=0 does NOT remove drag Reynolds correction.
Projection epsilon=max(0.25*chord, Cd*chord/2, 2*cbrt(V)*meshFactor) in metres, meshFactor=1. Sampling radius 1 is in epsilon units, equals 2dx only if mesh floor dominates on cubic cells.
Sampling envelope assumes abs(Cd)<=2; runtime epsilon and sampling containment must be verified if exceeded.

SGC constants use repository defaults, not identified article coefficients; calcAlphaEquiv=true enables equivalent incidence for article eq5 alpha-X-Y-Z. The 3G implementation is a Sheng-family counterpart, not equation-for-equation proof. Static-fit parameters still come from each profile; cylinder compatibility unverified.
Control retains v1.2 aerodynamic switches, but matched paper numerics make it a NUMERICALLY MATCHED CONTROL, not baseline-certified.
